title: Infrastructure
description: Scaffolding, tooling, and foundational setup. All Phase 1 beads are blocked until this epic is complete.
close_reason: All foundational infrastructure tasks (I1-I4) are complete and verified.

title: I1: Monorepo scaffold
description:
Create the full monorepo directory structure and base config files. This bead unblocks everything else.

Deliverables:
- api/ directory (empty Go module skeleton: go.mod, main.go stub)
- web/ directory (Vite+React+TS: run npm create vite, add Tailwind, init shadcn)
- seeds/ directory with empty placeholder files (spells.json=[], character.json={}, crit_table.json=[])
- docker-compose.yml with two services: api (Go) and web (nginx)
- nginx.conf: serves web/dist as static files, proxies /api/* to api:8080
- .gitignore covering Go binaries, node_modules, dist, .env

Acceptance criteria:
- docker-compose.yml is valid (docker compose config passes)
- web/ has a working Vite dev server (npm run dev starts without errors)
- api/ has a valid go.mod
- All directories exist with their placeholder files

title: I2: Go API foundation
description:
Build the Go backend foundation: HTTP server, SQLite connection, migration runner, and seed loader.

Read docs/all.md and docs/backend.md before starting.

Deliverables:
- main.go: HTTP server on :8080, router wired, graceful shutdown
- internal/db/db.go: open SQLite, run migrations in order, run seed loader
- internal/db/migrations/001_init.sql: characters table with all core scalar columns
- internal/db/migrations/002_ledgers.sql: hp_events and xp_events append-only tables
- internal/db/migrations/003_state.sql: active_buffs, spell_slots, round_state tables
- Seed loader: reads seeds/character.json at startup if characters table is empty
- Health check endpoint: GET /api/health returns {status: ok}

Acceptance criteria:
- go build ./... succeeds with no errors
- go test ./... passes (write a test that opens an in-memory SQLite DB and runs all migrations)
- GET /api/health returns 200 {status: ok}
- Server starts and seeds character from seeds/character.json on first run
- seeds/character.json schema is documented in a comment in db.go
close_reason: Go API foundation: chi router, SQLite, migrations, seed loader, health endpoint

title: I4: Spell data scrape — seeds/spells.json
description:
Scrape vodabois.fi/2eSpells and produce seeds/spells.json covering all Wizard and Priest spells with full metadata.

This is a data preparation bead, not a TDD bead. Output quality matters more than test coverage.

Steps:
1. Fetch and inspect the site structure at vodabois.fi/2eSpells
2. Identify the data shape (spell name, level, class, casting time, range, duration, area of effect, components, description)
3. Extract all Wizard spells first, then Priest spells
4. Produce seeds/spells.json as a JSON array of spell objects with consistent field names (snake_case)
5. Document the schema in a comment at the top of the file or in a companion seeds/spells.schema.json

Acceptance criteria:
- seeds/spells.json is valid JSON (jq . seeds/spells.json succeeds)
- Contains at least all Wizard spells levels 1-6 (Bard spell range)
- Every spell has at minimum: name, level, class, casting_time, range, duration, area_of_effect
- Schema is documented
close_reason: Scraped 885 spells (511 Wizard + 374 Priest) from vodabois.fi/2eSpells

title: Actor Module: Deepen Character logic
description: Create a deep Actor module that encapsulates stats, HP ledger, and active buffs. Move character-specific rules and orchestration from handlers/engine into this module. Interface: Actor.Hit(weapon, targetAC), Actor.ApplyBuff(effect), Actor.TakeDamage(delta, source).

title: Effect Engine: Type-safe modifier management
description: Create a deep EffectEngine to manage the lifecycle and application of modifiers, replacing the map[string]any pattern. Interface: EffectEngine.Aggregate(activeBuffs).
close_reason: Effect Engine implemented with full type safety. Replaced map[string]any with strongly-typed BuffEffects struct and introduced the EffectEngine module for modifier aggregation and requirement checking. All tests pass.

title: Roll Trace Module: Decouple explanation from math
description: Create a deep RollTrace module to record the 'explanation' of a roll, hiding the complexity of string formatting and modifier tracking. Interface: Trace.Roll(sides), Trace.AddModifier(source, value), Trace.Explain(formula).

title: F1: HP Ledger
description:
Full vertical slice: append-only HP ledger with Go engine, REST endpoints, and React left panel integration.

Read docs/all.md, docs/backend.md, and docs/frontend.md before starting.

Backend deliverables:
- internal/domain/hp.go: HpEvent struct, AppendEvent(), GetCurrentHP() (SELECT SUM(delta)), GetHistory()
- internal/handlers/hp.go: POST /api/hp/event {delta, source}, GET /api/hp (returns current + max + recent events)
- UndoLastEvent via a correction row (insert negative of last delta, not a DELETE)

Frontend deliverables:
- LeftPanel.tsx: HP bar (colored: green >50%, yellow 25-50%, red <25%), current/max display, last 5 events list
- Damage entry: input field + source label + Submit button → POST /api/hp/event
- Heal entry: same pattern with positive delta
- stores/hp.ts: Zustand store with fetchHp, appendEvent

Acceptance criteria:
- go test ./internal/domain/... passes: append event, derive current HP, undo produces correct sum
- POST /api/hp/event with delta=-10 source='sword' returns updated HP state
- GET /api/hp returns current HP = SUM of all events
- HP bar color changes correctly at 50% and 25% thresholds
- npm run typecheck passes

title: F2: Combat Roll Resolution
description:
Full vertical slice: THAC0 attack resolution, D20+D100 crit check, damage formula with stubbed buff modifiers, REST endpoint, React center panel.

Read docs/all.md, docs/backend.md, and docs/frontend.md before starting.

IMPORTANT: seeds/crit_table.json may not exist yet. If missing, implement the crit multiplier lookup but return a stubbed multiplier of 2 and leave a TODO comment. Do not block on this.

Backend deliverables:
- internal/engine/dice.go: RollD20(), RollD100(), RollDie(sides int) — accept seeded rand.Source for tests
- internal/engine/combat.go: ResolveAttack(weapon, targetAC, character, activeBuffs) returns RollResult
  - Rolls D20 + D100 simultaneously
  - Checks crit: (D20 - D100) >= required_to_hit
  - If crit: rolls second D100, looks up crit_table.json for multiplier
  - Resolves damage: ((BaseDamage × SpellsBuff) + WeaponBuff) × Multipliers + StrengthBonus
  - Buff modifiers (SpellsBuff, WeaponBuff from Power Gem) stubbed as identity values (1.0, 0) for now
- internal/handlers/combat.go: POST /api/roll/attack {weapon_id, target_ac}
- RollResult struct as defined in docs/backend.md

Frontend deliverables:
- CenterPanel.tsx Combat tab: weapon selector, target AC input, Roll Attack button
- RollResult display: full breakdown shown (every modifier labeled), hit/miss in large text
- api/combat.ts: typed fetch wrapper
- stores/combat.ts: last roll result state
- types/combat.ts: RollResult TypeScript interface

Acceptance criteria:
- go test ./internal/engine/...: deterministic tests with seeded RNG covering hit, miss, crit, damage formula
- Damage formula tested: each factor verified independently and combined
- Multipliers stack multiplicatively (2x * 3x = 6x, not 5x)
- POST /api/roll/attack returns complete RollResult breakdown
- Full breakdown renders in React — never just the final number
- npm run typecheck passes
close_reason: Re-closing previously implemented vertical slices that were incorrectly reset. Verified with scripts/validate.sh and manual smoke tests.

title: F3: Active Buffs + Round Counter
description:
Full vertical slice: buff activation/dismissal, charge/duration tracking, round counter, expiry alerts, and wire buff modifiers into F2 damage formula.

Read docs/all.md, docs/backend.md, and docs/frontend.md before starting.

Backend deliverables:
- internal/domain/buff.go: BuffEffect struct, two types: charge-based (decrement on trigger) and duration-based (decrement on round advance)
- internal/engine/buffs.go: ApplyBuffModifiers(activeBuffs) returns SpellsBuff, WeaponBuff, Multipliers — wires into ResolveAttack()
- internal/handlers/buffs.go: POST /api/buffs (activate), DELETE /api/buffs/:id (dismiss), POST /api/buffs/:id/trigger (decrement charge)
- internal/handlers/round.go: POST /api/round/advance — increments round counter, decrements all duration buffs, returns list of expired buffs
- Update ResolveAttack() in engine/combat.go to consume real buff modifiers instead of stubs

Frontend deliverables:
- LeftPanel.tsx: active buffs list — each buff shows name + remaining charges/rounds as Badge
- Buff activation: name input + type selector (charge/duration) + value + activate button
- Manual dismiss button per buff

- Toast notification when a buff expires (shadcn Toast)
- stores/buffs.ts, api/buffs.ts, types/buff.ts

- go test: duration buff decrements on round advance, expires correctly
- go test: ApplyBuffModifiers correctly feeds SpellsBuff/WeaponBuff/Multipliers into damage formula
- Power Gem buff (weapon_buff=5, multiplier=2, requires str=18) applies correctly in a damage roll
- POST /api/round/advance returns expired buffs in response

title: F4: Spell Slots
description:
Full vertical slice: daily spell slot tracking, cast decrement, long rest reset, and React center panel.

Read docs/all.md, docs/backend.md, and docs/frontend.md before starting.

NOTE: This bead depends on I4 (seeds/spells.json) for the spell database. If I4 is not done, implement the slot tracking without spell metadata display — just slot counts by level.

Backend deliverables:
- internal/domain/spell.go: SpellSlot struct {level, prepared_spell_name, used bool}, Spell struct matching seeds/spells.json schema
- Spell slot state stored as JSON column in spell_slots table (seeded from character.json)
- internal/handlers/spells.go:
  - GET /api/spells/slots — returns all slots with prepared spell names and used status
  - POST /api/spells/:id/cast — marks slot as used, returns updated slot state
  - POST /api/spells/reset — long rest: marks all slots as unused

Frontend deliverables:
- CenterPanel.tsx Spells tab: slots grouped by level, each slot shows spell name + Cast button (disabled if used)
- Used slots visually dimmed, remaining count per level shown
- Long Rest button resets all slots
- stores/spells.ts, api/spells.ts, types/spell.ts

Acceptance criteria:
- go test: cast decrements available slot, double-cast on same slot rejected (409)
- go test: long rest reset marks all slots unused
- GET /api/spells/slots returns correct state after cast
- React shows correct used/available state per level
- npm run typecheck passes
close_reason: Feature implemented and verified. Spell slots tracking, casting logic, and UI integration are fully functional.
